original_test_intent: Verify a fully populated system completes 100 OS warm-reboot cycles at 40C/+5% rails with consistent boot readiness, complete device enumeration and no unexpected errors.

safety_requirements: Stop on boot loop/hang/device loss/thermal fault
agent_execution_scope: No environment control or PASS claim
